name: io.github.zachshallbetter/adobe-mcp-suite
title: Adobe MCP Suite
description: Local MCP coordinator for cross-app Adobe workflows.

environmentVariables.name: ADOBE_MCP_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Applications to load, comma-separated: indesign, illustrator, photoshop, aftereffects, premiere. Defaults to InDesign and Illustrator

environmentVariables.name: ADOBE_TARGET
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared execution target, including adobe, craft, artcraft, or auto

environmentVariables.name: ADOBE_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared execution backend, including extendscript, uxp, craft, or auto

environmentVariables.name: TARGET
environmentVariables.description: Alias for ADOBE_TARGET when choosing the shared execution target

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Alias for ADOBE_BACKEND when choosing the shared execution backend

environmentVariables.name: ARTCRAFT_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Probe a compatible local ArtCraft app when the selected backend is auto

environmentVariables.name: ARTCRAFT_CONTROL_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Fallback loopback port for local ArtCraft control connections

environmentVariables.name: ARTCRAFT_CONTROL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Fallback authentication token for local ArtCraft control connections

environmentVariables.name: ARTCRAFT_CONTROL_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File containing the fallback ArtCraft control token

environmentVariables.name: INDESIGN_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories InDesign tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: ILLUSTRATOR_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories Illustrator tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: PHOTOSHOP_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories Photoshop tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: AFTEREFFECTS_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories After Effects tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: PREMIERE_ALLOWED_DIRS
environmentVariables.description: Extra directories Premiere Pro tools may read and write (':' on macOS, ';' on Windows)

environmentVariables.name: PREMIERE_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Loopback port used to connect the Premiere Pro UXP plugin; defaults to 3011

environmentVariables.name: UXP_BRIDGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: InDesign UXP bridge URL; defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3000

environmentVariables.name: BRIDGE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared secret for the local InDesign or Premiere Pro UXP bridge
